summary: Round 1 had no findings. Since 6c4fb32 the only code changes are e2e test files: e2e/support/paused-clock.ts (new runUntil helper, runUntilMyTurn now delegates to it), e2e/worker-delay-hand.spec.ts (new), and loop replacements in action-bar, next-hand, review, table-display and table specs. git diff vs base 341563c shows no src/ change and no package.json/package-lock.json change, so no new dependencies. paused-clock.ts is not imported from src/ (the only src mention is a pre-existing comment in src/ui/advice/advice-client.ts), so nothing reaches the shipped bundle. runUntil only loops page.clock.runFor and stops at both a fake-time bound and a real-time bound, so it cannot spin forever. delayWorkerReplies is unchanged and still passes its test-controlled ms through Number(). No untrusted input, secrets, file I/O or randomness is involved. No findings.
